d.title: Ushio to Tora: Comical Deformer Gekijou
d.en: Ushio and Tora: Comically Deformed Theater
d.jp: うしおととら コミカル・デフォルメ劇場
d.synopsis: Ushio encounters a strange purple monster that seems to be helpful, Tora deals with a kitten, and finally there is a mass chase, reprising all of the monsters from the OVA series.
